# clickhouse_role (Resource)

Manage a SQL role and its complete set of explicit database/table grants. Each role has one owner. Grants omitted from configuration are revoked on apply. `grants = []` removes every supported direct privilege while preserving the role.



`cluster` is explicit: omitting it creates a local role, even when the provider has `default_cluster`. Clustered access resources require `verify_replicas = true` and `replica_hosts` covering every member. The provider checks coverage using `system.clusters` and each connection's `is_local` member entries. Every replica must be reachable for refresh, updates, and deletion. Cluster membership uses the configured native port.

Refresh only reads state. A missing role or different grants on any replica sets `replicas_in_sync` to false; the next apply reconciles the complete declared grant set. A role missing everywhere is removed from state. Failed distributed operations can partially complete: failed creates retain ownership after collision checks, and failed operations need a refresh and plan review before recovery. Failed creations may be marked tainted; explicitly resolve that status before a recovery apply to avoid an unintended replacement. The provider never replaces an existing role implicitly or deletes it as rollback.

Only SQL roles in `local_directory` access storage are supported. XML and replicated access storage, inherited roles, column grants, partial revokes, grant options, and external-source privileges fail with an explicit diagnostic. Existing conflicting entities must be imported explicitly. Changing `name` or `cluster` replaces the resource, so review replacement plans before applying.

Supported atomic privileges are `SELECT`, `INSERT`, `CREATE DATABASE`, `CREATE TABLE`, `CREATE VIEW`, `CREATE DICTIONARY`, `DROP DATABASE`, `DROP TABLE`, `DROP VIEW`, `DROP DICTIONARY`, `SHOW DATABASES`, `SHOW TABLES`, `SHOW COLUMNS`, `SHOW DICTIONARIES`, `TRUNCATE`, `OPTIMIZE`, and the listed granular ALTER privileges in `pkg/resources/role/validators.go`. Broad privilege groups such as `ALL` and `ALTER` are rejected. Privileges are normalized to uppercase. Database/table names are exact identifiers or the complete wildcard `*`; prefix wildcards and redundant overlapping scopes are rejected.

The provisioning account needs authority to create/drop roles and grant/revoke each declared privilege. Runtime users only need their assigned application roles. Provisioning credentials are separate from runtime credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "clickhouse_host" {
  type = string
}

variable "clickhouse_replica_hosts" {
  type = list(string)
}

variable "clickhouse_username" {
  type = string
}

variable "clickhouse_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "clickhouse" {
  host            = var.clickhouse_host
  port            = 9000
  username        = var.clickhouse_username
  password        = var.clickhouse_password
  verify_replicas = true
  replica_hosts   = var.clickhouse_replica_hosts
}

resource "clickhouse_role" "orders_reader" {
  name    = "orders_reader"
  cluster = "main"
  grants = [
    {
      database   = "sonic_system"
      table      = "orders"
      privileges = ["SELECT"]
    },
    {
      database   = "service_events"
      table      = "*"
      privileges = ["INSERT"]
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `grants` (Set of Object) Complete set of direct database/table grants. An empty set grants no direct privileges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))
- `name` (String) Immutable SQL role name.

### Optional

- `cluster` (String) Explicit immutable ON CLUSTER target. Empty means local; provider default_cluster is not inherited.
- `replicas_in_sync` (Boolean) Must remain true in configuration. Refresh records false when replicas diverge, scheduling reconciliation.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Imports identify scope explicitly and never recover or change credentials:

```shell
terraform import clickhouse_role.orders_reader '["main","orders_reader"]'
terraform import clickhouse_role.local_reader '["","local_reader"]'
```

Import and refresh expose existing direct grants for review. Unsupported rights or inherited roles must be resolved before adopting the entity. Do not manage the same role from another stack or a server startup script.
